map.奈奎斯特采样（f_s ≥ 2·f_max） 使用指南: Nyquist Sampling (f_s >= 2 x f_max) User Guide
map.输入信号最高频率 f_max，按 f_s ≥ 2·f_max 计算奈奎斯特最小采: Enter the highest signal frequency f_max and compute the Nyquist minimum sampling rate as f_s >= 2 x f_max, for ADC selection and anti-aliasing design that avoids reconstruction distortion.
map.无失真重建连续信号所需最小采样率为信号最高频率的两倍。: The minimum sampling rate needed to reconstruct a continuous signal without distortion is twice the highest frequency of the signal.
map.最高频率 fmax 的两倍即最低无混叠采样率。: Twice the highest frequency fmax is the minimum aliasing-free sampling rate.
map.对比不同 fmax 的采样要求。: Compare sampling requirements for different fmax.
map.：奈奎斯特率 fs = 2 × 20000 = 40000 Hz = 40 kH: The Nyquist rate fs = 2 x 20000 = 40000 Hz = 40 kHz, and a CD at 44.1 kHz leaves margin.
map.：若 fmax=1MHz，则至少需 2MHz 采样，否则高频混叠到低频。: If fmax = 1 MHz, at least 2 MHz sampling is needed, otherwise high frequencies alias into low frequencies.
map.由中心频率与带宽求品质因数: Quality factor from center frequency and bandwidth
map.实际采样率要正好 2fmax 吗？: Must the sampling rate be exactly 2 fmax?
map.应高于 2fmax 并加抗混叠滤波，留过渡带余量以防混叠。: It should be above 2 fmax with anti-aliasing filtering added, leaving transition-band margin to prevent aliasing.
map.采样不足时高频分量折叠成低频虚假分量，破坏信号真实性。: When sampling is insufficient, high-frequency components fold into false low-frequency components, destroying signal fidelity.
